label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 119 ]

blocks.text: Babies experience anxiety when they see strangers. Children aged 2 through 6 show anxiety about things not based in reality such as ghosts. Kids aged 7 through 12 often fear real situations that may happen to them, such as injuries or accidents. As a child grows, fears may disappear. For example, a child who couldn't sleep with the light off at age 5 may enjoy ghost stories years later. And some fears may extend only to one kind, as in the example of the child who wants to pet a lion at the zoo but wouldn't dream of petting the neighbor's dog.

readingSentences.korean: 2~6세 아이들은 유령처럼 현실에 근거하지 않은 것에 불안을 보인다.

readingSentences.english: Kids aged 7 through 12 often fear real situations that may happen to them, such as injuries or accidents.
readingSentences.korean: 7~12세 아이들은 다치거나 사고를 당하는 것처럼 실제로 일어날 수 있는 상황을 자주 두려워한다.

readingSentences.english: As a child grows, fears may disappear.
readingSentences.korean: 아이가 자라면서 두려움은 사라질 수 있다.

readingSentences.english: For example, a child who couldn't sleep with the light off at age 5 may enjoy ghost stories years later.
readingSentences.korean: 예를 들어 다섯 살 때 불을 끄고는 잠들지 못하던 아이가 몇 년 뒤에는 귀신 이야기를 즐길 수도 있다.

readingSentences.english: And some fears may extend only to one kind, as in the example of the child who wants to pet a lion at the zoo but wouldn't dream of petting the neighbor's dog.
readingSentences.korean: 또 어떤 두려움은 한 종류에만 해당하기도 한다. 동물원의 사자는 쓰다듬고 싶어 하면서 옆집 개를 쓰다듬는 것은 꿈도 꾸지 못하는 아이가 그런 예다.
